einzeiler: The final countdown to 9/11 as the hijackers prepare and US intelligence misses clues.
kurzfassung: In the weeks leading up to September 11, operational leader Mohammed Atta finalized the dates, targets, and flight schedules while managing doubts within his team. Meanwhile, US intelligence agencies received numerous warnings of an impending al-Qaeda attack but lacked specific actionable details. On the eve of the attacks, the hijackers completed their spiritual and practical preparations in hotels near their departure airports.
stichpunkte: Mohammed Atta directed pilot training, logistics, and target coordination from the United States.
Concerns arose over pilot Ziad Jarrah, leading Khalid Sheikh Mohammed to prepare Zacharias Moussaoui as a potential backup.
Atta and Ramzi bin al-Shib met in Spain to finalize operational plans despite Osama bin Laden's impatience.
The target list included the World Trade Center and the Pentagon, with ongoing debate over the White House or Capitol.
US intelligence detected multiple threat indicators during the summer of 2001, summarized in an August Presidential Daily Brief.
CIA Director George Tenet warned National Security Advisor Condoleezza Rice that the system was blinking red.
Atta communicated the attack date using a coded message involving numbers and objects.
Hijackers gathered in departure cities and followed a detailed spiritual and practical manual on their final night.

clips.hook: The muscle stay low while the pilots train at a frenzied pace.
clips.text: The operational roles diverged sharply, with support operatives blending into the background while the pilots engaged in intensive training.

clips.hook: A one-way ticket and an unusual airport drop-off raise suspicions.
clips.text: Ziad Jarrah received a one-way ticket from his girlfriend and was personally driven to the airport by Atta before meeting his handler in Germany.

clips.hook: George Tenet demands an urgent meeting to warn of spectacular attacks.
clips.text: The CIA director took the rare step of requesting an immediate audience with the national security advisor to report on impending multiple attacks with no warning.

clips.hook: Two branches and a lollipop: the cryptic code for the attack date.
clips.text: Mohammed Atta communicated the specific date of the operation to his logistical coordinator using a bizarre numerical and symbolic riddle.

clips.hook: A disturbing manual dictated the final hours on earth.
clips.text: Recovered documents outlined a ritualistic guide for the hijackers' last night, framing their actions through intense spiritual imagery rather than politics.

beschreibung:
By July 2001 the plan for 9/11 was almost complete… All that was missing was a day. How do you set the date the world changes?

Listen as David and Gordon unpack the night before the 9/11 hijackers carried out their plot.
